```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(knitr)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
```



```{r data cleaning}
# Preserve IDs as text to avoid rounding large identification numbers.
airbnb_raw <- read_csv(
  "listings.csv",
  na = c("", "NA", "N/A"),
  col_types = cols(
    id = col_character(),
    host_id = col_character(),
    price = col_character(),
    host_is_superhost = col_character()
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Confirm that each listing appears once.
stopifnot(
  !anyNA(airbnb_raw$id),
  anyDuplicated(airbnb_raw$id) == 0L
)

# Select the response, ten predictors, and IDs for later checks.
airbnb_selected <- airbnb_raw %>%
  transmute(
    listing_id = id,
    host_id = host_id,

    # Response: advertised nightly price in CAD.
    price = parse_number(price),

    # Numerical predictors.
    bedrooms = bedrooms,
    beds = beds,
    review_rating = review_scores_rating,
    guest_capacity = accommodates,
    host_listings = host_listings_count,
    number_of_reviews = number_of_reviews,
    minimum_nights = minimum_nights,

    # Categorical predictors.
    superhost = factor(
      host_is_superhost,
      levels = c("f", "t"),
      labels = c("No", "Yes")
    ),
    room_type = relevel(
      factor(room_type),
      ref = "Entire home/apt"
    ),
    neighbourhood = factor(neighbourhood_cleansed)
  )

# Define model variables explicitly: IDs are not predictors.
predictors <- c(
  "bedrooms",
  "beds",
  "superhost",
  "review_rating",
  "guest_capacity",
  "host_listings",
  "room_type",
  "number_of_reviews",
  "minimum_nights",
  "neighbourhood"
)

model_variables <- c("price", predictors)

# Record missingness BEFORE excluding incomplete observations.
missing_summary <- data.frame(
  variable = model_variables,
  missing_n = vapply(
    airbnb_selected[model_variables],
    function(x) sum(is.na(x)),
    integer(1)
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    missing_percent = round(
      100 * missing_n / nrow(airbnb_selected), 1
    )
  )

# Require an observed, finite, positive nightly price.
airbnb_priced <- airbnb_selected %>%
  filter(is.finite(price), price > 0)

# Use a consistent complete-case sample for the preliminary model.
airbnb_clean <- airbnb_priced %>%
  drop_na(all_of(model_variables)) %>%
  droplevels()

# Record how the analysis sample was obtained.
cleaning_summary <- data.frame(
  stage = c(
    "Original listings",
    "Observed positive price",
    "Complete data for all model variables"
  ),
  listings = c(
    nrow(airbnb_raw),
    nrow(airbnb_priced),
    nrow(airbnb_clean)
  )
)

# Verify the project sample-size requirement and numerical validity.
stopifnot(
  nrow(airbnb_clean) >= 1000,
  !anyNA(airbnb_clean[model_variables]),
  all(vapply(
    select(airbnb_clean, where(is.numeric)),
    function(x) all(is.finite(x)),
    logical(1)
  ))
)
```
